title: Specific Reference Question Strategy

notes.html:
A Specific Reference Question asks you for what the author meant when they used a specific word or phrase.

Example Specific Reference Question Stems

  • It can be inferred from the passage that the author uses the phrase "---------------" primarily to refer to

  • The author uses the phrase "---------------" primarily in order to refer to the risks resulting from

NOTE: Actually, LSAC changed the test format and the reference is no longer highlighted. The reference will be generally referenced in the question stem.
